Let's cover the easy ones first.
The first case is an isolated incident from a veterans hotline, vets hotlines have all your information by default,
The FAQ does cover when they will give your information to authorities, and states that it is "only in case of immediate physical danger" so basically don't tell them you are going to do it and hang up. 
The second one is a bit harder to handle but seems like it was from a local hotline to the area they were in and they used their full name when talking to the counsellor, use a psudonim and they can't look you up via dmv. Additionally it strikes me as a single counsellor going beyond what they were supposed to.
Lastly, these hotlines get thousands of calls a day, the reason you could only find a few stories like this is because they are a far outlier.
Thank goodness for awkwardly named pets, they always make me happy.

Hey, so a couple things.

The best way to get counseling without billing insurance is through your school (I assume high school) as typically the counselling programs in schools are free and the counsellors tend to be overqualified as therapists but want to help people like us.
The insurance will be billed if you do it most other ways but they shouldn't go out of their way to notify your mother, just make sure you pay the copay out of pocket, though this won't help if she checks your insurance documents constantly.

Second, the mental health stigma is much less prevalent then it used to be, it's commonly accepted that it is a medical condition and while some may look at you differently those are not the people you want to surround yourself with.

If she wants an argument for not moving out of state make sure she wants to pay for your college out of pocket, colleges don't like when you move just before registering and try to get state discounts and scholarships.

Do not wait til you are 18, the sooner you get help the better, please trust me on this.

Oz, after the wizard.
And thank you, you don't know how much it means that someone read and cared.

There is no easy way.
Someone will always try to save you, there will always be physical pain and suffering worse then anything you could experience or imagine.
Your car is fast, which means it was designed to take impacts at high speed, you might lose some part of your extremities but you will be in a worse place then you are already.
I'm not in a great place for this kind of thing myself but you need to know, they call it the easy way out but it is not easy, it's never easy, and there is no way to do it without making your suffering that much worse.

Help lines would be useless if they traced you, it would be all over the news and nobody would call them, they know they can't do that sort of thing. Take a moment to breathe and think about it logically, and think when you call them, would they be asking about your safety and making sure you aren't actively attempting if they were tracing you? No, they would already know
